title: (Deprecated) Run a report
content_data:
Use this endpoint to run a report of dynamic scene videos. > **Note**
The Dynamic Scene API is now in beta. If you would like access to this feature, please apply for the allowlisting using the [Allowlist Management](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/blog/detail/7102266224578396162) page. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/dynamic_scene/report/get/| /v1.3/dynamic_scene/report/get/| |Request parameter data type |`advertiser_id`: number |`advertiser_id`: string | ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/dynamic_scene/report/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable | Field | Data Type | Description | |---|---|---| | advertiser_id {Required} |string| Advertiser ID | | data_level {Required}| string | The data level that you'd like to query in reports. Currently we only support `ADGROUP`. | | input_ids {Required} | string[] | IDs of the `data level` fields. Currently we only support ad group id. | | dimensions {Required} | string[] | Grouping conditions. For example: `["campaign_id", "stat_time_day"]` indicates that both campaign_id and stat_time_day (days) are grouped.
Currently, we only support the value of`[advertiser_id, adgroup_id, story_arc, order, video_id]` in this field. Make sure that you've passed all the values of `[advertiser_id, adgroup_id, story_arc, order, video_id]` in this field.| | metrics | string[] | Metrics to query. Refer to the Response section for details. | | start_time | string | Query start date in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD`. The date is based on the ad account time zone. | | end_time | string | Query end date in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD`. The date is based on the ad account time zone.

Note: The start time and end time should be no more than one year apart. | | order_field | string | Sort field. All supported metrics (excluding attribute metrics) support sorting, not sorting by default.| | order_type | string | Sort. Enum values: `ASC`, `DESC`. Default value: `DESC` .| | filters | object[] | Filter criteria. | #| field_name | string | Filter name. Enum values: `story_arc`, `order`. | #| filter_type | string | Filter type. We currently support `IN` in this field. | #| filter_value | string | The value to filter. When `filter_type = IN`, `filter_value` needs to be a valid JSON array character string.
If `filter_name` is `order` and you want to pass in all order options, specify `-1` in the field. | | page | number | Current number of pages. Default value: `1`. | | page_size | number | Pagination size. Value range: 1-1000. Default value: `10`. | ``` ### Example ``` xcodeblock (code curl http) { "advertiser_id": 6865632230773882886, "data_level": "ADGROUP", "input_ids": ["1734945725409298"], "dimensions": ["advertiser_id", "adgroup_id", "story_arc", "order", "video_id"], "order_field": "complete_plays", "start_time": "2022-06-09", "end_time": "2022-06-15", "filters": [ {"field_name": "story_arc", "filter_type": "IN", "filter_value": "[\"wing display\", \"wing display\", \"wing display\", \"wing display\", \"Ending CTA\"]"}, {"field_name": "order", "filter_type": "IN", "filter_value": "[\"-1\"]"} ] } (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |list |object[]|Returned data.| #|dimension|object|Dimension data.| ##|advertiser_id|string|Advertiser ID.| ##| adgroup_id|string|Ad group ID.| ##|story_arc|string|Refers to the structure and shape of a story, consisting of multiple slots. | ##|order|number|The order of the story arc, ranging from 0 to 5.| ##|video_id|string|IDs of all videos that have been created. | #|metric|object|Metric data.| ##| clicks|float|The number of clicks your video receives.| ##| complete_plays|float|The number of times your video is played to completion.| ##| break_plays|float|The number of times that people drop off on your video.| ##| ctr|float|The number of clicks that your video receives divided by the number of times your video is shown.| ##| complete_play_rate|float|The number of times that your video is played to completion divided by the number of times your video starts to play.| ##| break_play_rate|float|The number of times that people drop off on your video divided by the number of times your video starts to play.| |request_id |string|The log id of the request, which uniquely identifies a request | ``` ### Example ``` xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "202206240742360102452460661D20FC4D", "data": {
